zoe (Marketing): PartnerHub wants a joint marketplace listing + 30m webinar + short benchmark callout. Target ~3 weeks. Who owns what?

matt (Partnerships): we can provide logos + a single benchmark slide. partner legal needs 48h for quote approval. Prefer May 28 or 30.

ira (Growth): Routing: create SFDC campaign 'PH_Marketplace_May'. utm_source=partnerhub, utm_campaign=ph_may_launch. Gate recording for lead capture. I'll set up webhook to lead lambda; need auth from eng.

ana (Content): I'll draft marketplace blurb (3 bullets), a 600-800 word launch post, and registration copy. Can have blurbs + landing copy by Tue. Need the benchmark stat and screenshots.

zoe (Marketing): owners: ana -> content, ira -> tracking, matt -> partner assets/legal. I'll manage promo calendar and host.

calendar-bot: Event proposed: "PartnerHub x Redwood  Launch Webinar" May 30 10:00 PT.

matt (Partnerships): sending assets Tue AM. will try to secure a joint customer quote but need permission window.

ira (Growth): registration fields: first/last name, email, company, role, monthly volume bracket. Hidden field "ph_ref" for attribution.

ana (Content): if eng can't confirm numbers, I'll use hedged language like "up to ~35% lower token cost". Please tag eng for sign-off if we want precise figures.

zoe (Marketing): Promo cadence: teaser 3w out, registration open 2w out, reminders 1w and 2d. Social banners due 10 days prior. Dry run one week before.

matt (Partnerships): all good here. excited to partner. :handshake:

ira (Growth): I'll set SFDC campaign + webhook today. ping me if you need field names.
